description: The two bulky supports of the team — Charjabug and the very tanky non-shadow Cetitan absorb damage and provide defensive backbone to enable the glass-cannon Shadow Ursaring to shred shields safely.

sources.author: HomeSliceHenry
sources.videoTitle: This player JUST HIT *LEGEND* with Shadow Ursaring in the Evolution Cup!

description: The two back-line sweepers of the team — once Floette generates a shield or switch advantage, Fletchinder and Primeape close out games. Fletchinder pressures grounded/steel threats with Fly + Heat Wave while Primeape banks Rage Fist energy and swings double-boosted Close Combats.

Floette's bulk and strong zero-shield matchups create the shield advantage that lets Primeape run rampant in the endgame; Primeape punishes any free energy the opponent concedes while walling apart from Fletchinder.
